result.summary: The home feed renders mostly correctly, but there are several visual defects: a duplicated restaurant card, text truncation in the horizontal carousel, an inconsistently styled favorite button, and content clipped by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards (same image placeholder, same 15–25 min, same €0.90 delivery), suggesting duplicated data in the list.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate results by restaurant ID before rendering the carousel.

issues.description: The third carousel card ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no ellipsis, and the card image is clipped hard against the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek to the scroll container and truncate long titles with an ellipsis instead of a hard cut.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) is cut in half by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating and delivery info with no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height to the scroll content so cards are never occluded.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card, dark/transparent background on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use one shared favorite-button component with a consistent background and contrast treatment over imagery.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible sliver of a chip at the right edge, which looks like a rendering glitch rather than an intentional scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/padding so a meaningful portion of the next chip is visible, or add a fade/gradient edge.

issues.description: Poké restaurant cards use a generic gray placeholder-looking illustration while other cards have rich photography, making them appear like failed image loads.
issues.suggestion: Supply real imagery or a branded, clearly intentional fallback graphic.

issues.description: Secondary metadata (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') uses light gray text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast.
